problems.explain: Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal, and ∠D is opposite ∠B: 9x − 8 = 8x − 1. Take 8x from both sides: x − 8 = −1; add 8: x = 7. Check: both come to 55°. (Adjacent angles are not equal unless every angle is 90°.) So x = 7.

prompt.v: ABCD is a parallelogram with ∠D = (9x − 9)⁠° and ∠C = (3x + 9)⁠°. What is x?

problems.text: parallelogram: angle D 9x - 9, angle C 3x + 9; find x
problems.explain: ∠C and ∠D are next to each other, and adjacent angles of a parallelogram add to 180° (co-interior angles between parallel sides): (3x + 9) + (9x − 9) = 180 gathers to 12x = 180. Divide by 12: x = 15. Check: 3(15) + 9 = 54 and 9(15) − 9 = 126, which add to 180. (Setting them equal is right for opposite angles, not adjacent ones.) So x = 15.

prompt.v: ABCD is a parallelogram with ∠D = (x + 20)⁠° and ∠A = (6x + 13)⁠°. What is ∠D, in degrees?

problems.text: parallelogram: angle D x + 20, angle A 6x + 13; find angle D
problems.explain: ∠A and ∠D are next to each other, and adjacent angles of a parallelogram add to 180° (co-interior angles between parallel sides): (6x + 13) + (x + 20) = 180 gathers to 7x + 33 = 180. Take away 33: 7x = 147; divide by 7: x = 21. So ∠D = 21 + 20 = 41°. (Setting them equal is right for opposite angles, not adjacent ones.) So ∠D = 41°.
